summary: ```markdown # CLO 2024.1 - Expansion Panel ## Introduction to the Extension Tool From the 2024.1 version, we have optimized the extension tool. Now, in the case of the entire board being left and right symmetrical and linked, the operation of the extension board is realized. In this video, let's learn in detail how to use the extension tool. ## Overview of Extension Tools In the extension tool storage in the 2D toolbar, you can see that there are two extension tools available: - **Extension Board Slice Point** - **Extension Board Slice Line** ### Using the Extension Board Slice Line Let's first look at the optimized extension tool. 1. Click on the **Extension Board Slice Line**. 2. The tool will switch to the Extension Board Slice Line mode. 3. You can see the icon and text prompt of the tool in the light bar. #### Steps for Extending Section 1 1. Click on the starting and end points of **Section 1** that need to be extended. 2. We want to use the tool to extend the front and bottom, so we select the extension for Section 1. 3. Once you complete the selection of Section 1, the text prompt of the time icon will change. #### Steps for Extending Section 2 1. Click on the starting and end points of **Section 2** that need to be extended. 2. Select the bottom line as Section 2. 3. Complete the selection of Section 2. ### Finalizing the Extension 1. Click on the **Extension Board Slice Window**. 2. Enter the total length value of the bottom and Section 2 according to the design requirements. 3. You can also enter the distance value that needs to be moved. 4. It is possible to enter a negative value to shorten the bottom. 5. All adjustments can be previewed in the 2D window. 6. After entering the desired values, click **OK**. The extension is completed for the front. ## Using the Extension Board Slice Point Next, let's see how to use another extension tool, the **Extension Board Slice Point**. ### Steps for Extending the Bottom of the Back Piece 1. Long press the **Extension Board Slice Line**. 2. Click on the **Extension Board Slice Point**. The tool will switch to this mode. 3. You can see the icon and text prompt of the tool on the light bar. 4. Click on the line to draw the baseline. #### Drawing the Baseline 1. Use the side view point of the back piece as the starting point. 2. An arrow pointing downwards will appear. You can press the **Shift** key to draw a vertical baseline line according to the instruction line. 3. The extension position at the bottom will serve as the end point. Click again to complete the baseline line. ### Completing the Extension 1. The light bar rotates clockwise to one side, and the plate on this side of the baseline line will be extended with the side view point as the center. 2. You can also shorten the bottom. A text prompt will appear on the light bar. 3. Press the **D** key to maintain the frequency during rotation. #### Final Adjustments 1. In the process of extension, the right-click button will bring up the extension dialogue. 2. You can enter the length of the plate to be extended or the angle of the extension. 3. After entering the required values, click **OK**. The back piece extension is now completed. ## Conclusion The above is the introduction to the extension tool. I hope this function can make you more efficient in completing the plate extension. ```
